title: Convention Center Parking Land Talk
summary:
*   City officials met in a special Executive Session to discuss confidential matters.
*   A primary focus of the closed-door meeting was the acquisition of land for Convention Center parking.
*   The session, which also covered general legal and personnel matters, concluded without any final decisions or actions being taken.
